definitions.explanation: Progress or advancement in scope, scale, or complexity, especially of societies, economies, or relationships.

examples.japanese: {経済|けいざい}が{急速|きゅうそく}に{発展|はってん}した。
{両国|りょうこく}の{関係|かんけい}が{発展|はってん}することを{望|のぞ}む。
examples.english: I hope the relations between the two countries will develop.

examples.japanese: {発展|はってん}{途上国|とじょうこく}への{支援|しえん}。

notes:
USAGE: {発展|はってん} emphasizes broader societal, economic, or relational progress. Compare with {発達|はったつ} which focuses on organic/individual development.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{発展|はってん}する (to develop, to expand)
・{発展|はってん}させる (to develop something)
・{発展|はってん}に{貢献|こうけん}する (to contribute to development)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{発展|はってん}{途上国|とじょうこく} (developing country)
・{経済|けいざい}{発展|はってん} (economic development)
・{発展|はってん}{的|てき} (developmental, progressive)
・{持続|じぞく}{可能|かのう}な{発展|はってん} (sustainable development)

CONTRAST:
・{発展|はってん} - development (scale, society, relationships)
・{発達|はったつ} - development (organic, individual)
・{開発|かいはつ} - development (creating new things)
・{進歩|しんぽ} - progress
